evaluations.evidence: create a new game
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible rule or contradictory behavior regarding creating a game.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires an incompatible invitation mechanism or forbids inviting via URL.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes a contradictory constraint on how a round/item must be entered.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: No other story mandates an incompatible visibility rule for session items.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes a contradictory rule about selecting items for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids adding items or imposes an incompatible constraint.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible constraint on editing items.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story mandates that items must not be deletable or requires preservation that directly contradicts deletion.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: This allows revealing estimates before all estimators have given theirs, which is incompatible with participant stories that require estimates be shown only after all have given (PP-033) and with participant desires to change estimates up until the last person or until draw completion (PP-034, PP-041).

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires a contradictory acceptance rule for the agreed estimate.

evaluations.evidence: "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: This behavior is specific and not in direct contradiction with other stories (it complements reveal/accept flows).

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: No other story mandates an incompatible approach for recording the agreed estimate.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids re-estimation or imposes a contradictory rule.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires an incompatible import mechanism or forbids importing.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible constraint on copying/pasting stories.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: While deletion of games (PP-020/PP-024) may make some games unavailable, no story mandates that games must never be deletable; thus there's no explicit contradictory rule.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: No other story mandates an incompatible constraint that would prevent viewing transcripts in all cases.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible rule preventing export; deletion stories do not explicitly forbid exporting prior to deletion.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: No contradictory constraint found in other stories about CSV export.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game, so stories and estimates for this game are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Although deletion removes stored data, no other story mandates permanent retention in a way that directly contradicts the ability for a moderator to delete a specific game; this describes an allowed action rather than a global prohibition on storage.

evaluations.evidence: create an account for the application
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes a contradictory requirement about account creation.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires a contradictory authentication approach that conflicts with this story.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible restriction on modifying account details.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account, so account information and games are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: This requests deletion rights for a moderator's account and games; although researchers want stored, non-identifiable results (PP-052), the backlog does not state an absolute requirement that prevents account-based deletion, so no explicit contradiction is present.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible timing display rule.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids email-based password reminders or imposes an incompatible constraint.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, ...} or {0, 1, 2, ...}
evaluations.rationale: No other story mandates a single fixed card set that would contradict offering choice between scales.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes a contradictory limit on number of estimators.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires that joining must use accounts only; this is compatible with moderators having accounts.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: No contradictory requirement about item visibility is present elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible rule about seeing session items.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: This shows presence of a submission but not its value; it does not directly conflict with the participant requirement to have estimates revealed simultaneously (PP-033).

evaluations.evidence: shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: This requires reveal only after all estimators have given their estimate, which conflicts with PP-009 that allows a moderator to show estimates immediately before all have given; also conflicts with stories that would permit early reveal.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: This presumes the draw remains incomplete until the last person selects and prevents early reveal; that is incompatible with PP-009 which allows the moderator to show estimates before all have selected (thus ending the window for changes early).

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids access to prior personal estimates; this is compatible with other stories about current-round reveal rules.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: This states a visibility need during discussion; it does not directly contradict other stories because reveal timing controls apply to showing values to all, and this story expects visibility during discussion.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible timing or permission restriction for starting a timer.

evaluations.evidence: two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: This is consistent with the timer-starting story and does not impose an incompatible rule.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids reviewing prior-round data; compatible with data storage and deletion behaviors as optional actions.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: No conflicting story requires varying card order across draws in a way that contradicts this request.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: This expects draws not to be completed until normal completion; PP-009 allows the moderator to complete/reveal early (show estimates immediately), which would end the ability to change early and thus is incompatible.

evaluations.evidence: small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible UI constraint about thumbnails.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires noncompliant markup; this is a developer-quality requirement and not conflicting.

evaluations.evidence: list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: No contradictory requirement about terminology or definitions is present.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes, so that the queries run as fast as possible
evaluations.rationale: This is an implementation/performance request and does not conflict with other functional stories.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: No other story mandates behavior incompatible with supporting these browsers.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: No story imposes an accessibility requirement that contradicts this; it's a compatible quality goal.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance expectation does not conflict with other stories' functional constraints.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible character-encoding constraint.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires URLs to be non-sensible or conflicts with predictable URL design.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: No contradictory requirement is present about error page behavior.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: This requests non-identifiable storage of results; although account/game deletion stories may remove specific records, the backlog does not state an absolute prohibition on storing de-identified results, so no explicit contradiction is present.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes a contradictory restriction preventing collection or reporting of usage metrics.
